Senses.Explanation: The Xinxin Ming's release couplet — only do not hate, do not love, and it opens clear — recited at hall seats, turned against itself, stocked with sage-and-tyrant examples, and interleaved with toads and moons from the Ming temples to the Qing hermitage seats. Tianyin Yuanxiu, at the Kaifeng temple in Deqing county, waits out the long silence, then gives the couplet: supreme way not hard, only beware choosing; only do not hate, do not love — and it opens clear — and the whisk points: up is heaven; down is earth, high is mountain, deep is water, man is man, woman is woman, monk is monk, lay is lay, old is old, young is young — how will you say the sentence that does not choose?; the whisk thrown down: what falls is no other thing, and criss-cross it is not dust; Yongjue Yuanxian, at the Baoshan hermitage hall, raises the Third Patriarch's Xinxin Ming for exactly this couplet — is that not heart and gall cut open for those to come? — and then turns it against itself: to say 'only beware' is already choosing; to say 'only do not' is already hate and love; and with a clarity to point to, how is that the final word?; know that the supreme way is neither hard nor easy, no choosing and no no-choosing, no hate-love and no no-hate-love, no clarity and no no-clarity — this old monk, though he does not fall into choosing and hate-love, borrows choosing and hate-love as a lead-in — how then to be excused?; this old monk is a grandson of the Caodong line, and recalls the words of Dongshan's house; Baiyu Jingsi, at the Longhua temple on Bian Mountain, stocks the couplet with examples: Yao and Shun make everyone who hears them glad, Jie and Zhou make everyone who hears them furious — that is choosing; the Buddha spread his hair over mud to make a seat for the lamp-lit one, Devadatta pushed a mountain and drove an elephant against the sage of the Shakya — that is hate and love; how to get beyond choosing and hate-love?; today the Wuxing patron feeds the assembly, greens one bowl each, gift-money one share each — wealth-giving and teaching-giving without difference; and where there is no difference — is there still choosing, still hate-love inside it?; hear one more ode: plum petals tender, willow buds long, last night the east wind crossed the low wall — that tiresome old thrush on the branch, note by note leaking out the good spring light. Yingning Zhijing, at the offering of the Huangxi laymen: three realms mind-only, the ten thousand forms consciousness-only — the windmill atop the banner-pole, three monkeys winnowing coins by night; supreme way not hard, only beware choosing — the stone man at midnight casts no shadow, and who can tell the source of the comings and goings?; only do not hate, do not love — and it opens clear — the toad at the bottom of the well swallows the moon, and at third watch the night-bright curtain is not spared; today this mountain monk cuts the rope-end for you: get it, and the world and the world-beyond are the great golden-winged bird splitting the sea to swallow the dragon, nothing in the way; Jinian Jingxian, instructing the assembly: supreme way not hard, only beware choosing — if it is so, why sort gold from sand, part jade from stone?; the staff lifted: handled thus, it works close; one knock: do you get it?; another knock: or do you not?; only do not hate, do not love — and it opens clear — and yet know there is one person not inside the clarity: does the assembly know this man?; one more knock, the staff thrown, back to the room; and Xiaotang Yunfen, instructing the assembly at the Zizhi hermitage: the old road few walk, the lone peak keeps no overnight guests; master Rang of Nanyue and state-master An of Songshan — their coming and going was never easy; in heaven, honored in heaven; among men, honored among men — only do not hate, do not love, and it opens clear; the patch-robed one arriving here says: it does not bar my going east or going west; but suddenly in the dark you knock against a pillar-side man who calls you straight out a blind man — is your heart content with that or not?
